title: Hickory DNS hickory-net 0.26.0 before 0.26.2 and hickory-proto 0.25.0 through 0.25.2 skip the check that a UDP…
description: Hickory DNS components hickory-net versions before 0.26.2 and hickory-proto versions 0.25.0 through 0.25.2 have a vulnerability where UDP DNS responses with an empty question section (QDCOUNT=0) bypass validation checks. This allows remote attackers who can inject spoofed UDP responses to circumvent question section matching and case-randomization checks, weakening DNS spoofing defenses.
